modules.name: Cost-aware RL tool selector
modules.scope_reason: The PPO-trained policy selects tool subsets from execution state using final-answer feedback and a correctness-cost reward. Under R2, this trained workflow-action policy is LLM-side even though it is invoked inside the harness; the surrounding execution remains a Harness module. The scorer is a small network over a frozen LLM, but R2 and R6 place a trained policy that selects workflow actions from feedback on the LLM side.
